propositions: A project-only criterion project.symbol-reference-completeness must be added to detect when a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory was enumerated by hand (e.g., with grep) rather than derived from the symbol graph
The criterion must route to plan_review only (not code_review), because project.* criterion ids cannot enter code-review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would produce dead moves

A coaching move keyed on project.symbol-reference-completeness must direct re-derivation using find_referencing_symbols plus string-literal sweep (monkeypatch.setattr/getattr/importlib) to address LSP-unresolvable sites
The criterion must be advisory (default_posture: advisory) without blocking_enabled, since it coaches method rather than correctness and blocking would gate process noisily
Code-review coaching moves were already overlay-driven (code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reads .rebar/code_review_moves.json), so no engine wiring was required

Detection is demonstrated live (7 runs; criterion fires reliably at validity 1.0 on incomplete inventories, including string-literal sites the LSP cannot resolve; correct null findings on complete inventories), while coaching move selection is controlled by the LLM coach and cannot be deterministically forced by configuration alone
